When the enemy is pushed past the center of the lane and your ally has a way to lock them down, close the angle with Graves E Quickdraw, then cast Graves W Smoke Screen along their escape route. If Vi engages with a shield from an ability, trade after the shield is gone.
Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, close in with Graves E Quickdraw and land an empowered basic attack from a position with no unit between you and Vi. Use Graves W Smoke Screen to cut off her vision, then follow up with Graves Q End of the Line. If Vi is near a wall, hit the wall with Q to trigger the explosion sooner. Finish with Graves R Collateral Damage.
Vi.phase: You’ll have the advantage over Vi as you survive the early game and scale, but be careful not to get caught first in the late game because of your short range.
Vi.teamfight: Don’t start the fight from the front. Wait until your allies draw attention, then enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw. Once you reach a damage dealer, stay positioned so no unit is between you and your target, and use Graves W Smoke Screen to cut off their vision. While Vi R Cease and Desist is available, don’t wander out of vision alone; stay within range of your allies’ protective abilities.

Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it’s charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging. If Viego E Harrowed Path appears on terrain, Viego may be camouflaged nearby, so avoid that path. When your health is low, fall back because you’re an easy target for Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If the duel drags on because of the healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King, get defensive stats first, then fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Viego.fight: After dodging the stun from Viego W Spectral Maw, close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks. If Viego R Heartbreaker is also down, you have a chance to chase. Use Graves E Quickdraw toward the enemy to build armor stacks, keep attacking, and look for a chance to use it again.
Viego.laning: Clear jungle camps quickly to gain levels and gold, and don’t force ganks when there’s no clear opportunity. Gank when the enemy is pushed past the center of the lane and your ally has a way to lock them down. Don’t push the lane toward the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path’s Black Mist appears; place a Control Ward or take another route around.
Viego.combo: After dodging Viego W Spectral Maw, close in with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks. Use Graves W Smoke Screen to cut off his vision, then follow up with Graves Q End of the Line. If Viego has his back to a wall, hit the wall with Graves Q End of the Line to trigger the explosion sooner. Finish with Graves R Collateral Damage.
Viego.escape: Treat a missed Viego W Spectral Maw as your window to engage. If only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, Viego can still escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so look especially for an opening before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back. Close the gap then with Graves E Quickdraw, and use Graves R Collateral Damage to manage distance as well.
Viego.phase: In the mid game, turn your strength into an advantage in objectives and vision. In this matchup, Graves gets stronger as he stacks, so surviving the early game makes you more favored as the game goes on. In the late game, though, be careful not to get caught first because of your short range.
Viego.teamfight: Don’t start the team fight. Wait until your allies draw attention, then enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw. Land basic attacks from a position with no other unit between you and your target. If an ally falls in front of Viego, don’t keep fighting near that spot. If Viego possesses them, create distance until he returns to his original body.

Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes greatly reduced damage and triggers a fear, so create distance with Graves E Quickdraw and re-engage after the fear. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits you, you can do nothing while suppressed, so keep plenty of distance from Warwick when his movement speed is increased and from areas without vision. When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position, so don’t stay around for long.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first and choose Mercury’s Treads to deal with the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Also prepare for the physical damage from his basic attacks. If healing makes the duel drag on, build defensive stats first, then fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, hold your burst and attack again after the fear triggers.
Warwick.laning: Graves clears camps quickly while Warwick clears the jungle slowly, so look for chances to invade early using lane priority. If there’s no clear gank opportunity, farm camps by using Graves Q End of the Line along a wall. When your health drops below half, account for Warwick W Blood Hunt, give up some farm, and recall.
Warwick.combo: After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers, close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks from an angle with no unit between you and Warwick. Then use Graves W Smoke Screen to cut off his vision, hit him with the explosion from Graves Q End of the Line, and finish with Graves R Collateral Damage. If you use Graves E Quickdraw just before reloading, you can load one shell and keep attacking.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; check whether Warwick can still use Warwick R Infinite Duress. In particular, close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw and Graves R Collateral Damage after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers and before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back.
Warwick.phase: In the mid game, use the added strength from Graves R Collateral Damage to secure objectives and vision. If you survive the early game, the matchup favors Graves more as he stacks and grows stronger. In the late game, though, be careful not to get caught first because of your short range and low magic resistance.
Warwick.teamfight: Don’t start the fight from the front. Wait until your allies draw Warwick’s attention, then enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw. If Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses an ally, unleash your counterattack while Warwick is held in place. When attacking, stay positioned so no unit is between you and your target.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the back stab of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike has hit you with two empowered attacks, use Graves E Quickdraw to get out of range before the third hit knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t attack from outside spear range.
XinZhao.build: Build armor first to counter Xin Zhao’s main damage. If Xin Zhao P Determination’s healing makes him difficult to kill, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, and look for a chance to fight right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge. Close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks from an angle with no units in between. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard activates, create distance and wait out his immunity before retaliating.
XinZhao.laning: If there’s no clear gank opportunity, farm the jungle quickly to gain levels and gold. Gank when the opponent is past the lane’s midpoint and an ally has a way to lock them down. Use Graves E Quickdraw to close the gap, then throw Graves W Smoke Screen along their escape route.
XinZhao.combo: After Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge, close in with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks. Use Graves W Smoke Screen at close range to cut off vision, then follow up with Graves Q End of the Line. If Xin Zhao has his back to a wall, aim Graves Q End of the Line at the wall to make the explosion hit sooner.
XinZhao.escape: When Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third hit is coming, use Graves E Quickdraw to get out of range. Right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge, you have a chance to close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw or Graves R Collateral Damage.
XinZhao.phase: In the mid game, turn Graves’ strength into objective and vision advantages. Graves becomes more favorable the longer he survives and builds up, but in the late game, avoid being caught first because of his short range.
XinZhao.teamfight: Don’t start the fight from the front with Graves. Wait for your allies to draw attention, then enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw. Keep some distance from your allies so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback doesn’t split your formation. Counterattack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, and when attacking, stay where no other unit is between you and your target.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge-up and knocks enemies airborne, so if you see him charging behind a wall, avoid the landing spot. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes slows and knocks you up, making it easy for him to catch you, you’re likely to take damage from Zac W Unstable Matter as well, which deals damage based on your max health, so keep your distance.
Zac.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling between your core items to counter healing from Zac P Cell Division. Choose Mercury’s Treads instead of Plated Steelcaps and build magic resistance to counter the magic damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac uses E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to close the gap. Approach with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks from an angle with no units in between. During the fight, step on the chunks of Zac’s body to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: If there’s no clear gank opportunity, farm the jungle quickly to gain levels and gold. Gank when the opponent is past the lane’s midpoint and an ally has a way to lock them down. Use Graves E Quickdraw to close the gap, then throw W Smoke Screen along their escape route.
Zac.combo: Once Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks from a position where no unit blocks you. After closing in, use W Smoke Screen to cut off vision and follow up with Q End of the Line. If Zac has his back to a wall, aim Q at the wall to make it explode immediately.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac uses E Elastic Slingshot, close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw or R Collateral Damage. If you have to meet Zac’s engage head-on, avoid the landing spot, then create distance to avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter.
Zac.phase: In this matchup, the longer you survive and build up, the more favorable it becomes, but Graves has short range and low magic resistance in the late game, so getting caught first is dangerous. Turn your early and mid game advantages into objective and vision control.
Zac.teamfight: Don’t start the fight from the front. Dodge or withstand Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s engage, then create distance to reduce damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Once your allies draw the enemy’s attention, enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw and get onto the carries. Stay where no unit is between you and your target. During the fight, step on the chunks of Zac’s body to prevent healing, and check whether Zac P Cell Division’s revive is available.

Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and slows you, and also resets the cooldown of Bel’Veth Q Void Surge, so dodge to the side when she closes in. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes, so save Graves Q End of the Line and Graves R Collateral Damage while it’s active. Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet heals and deals true damage, so be especially careful when your health is low.
Belveth.build: Bel’Veth’s main damage from Q Void Surge and E Royal Maelstrom is physical, so build armor first. Fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items to counter healing from Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Bel’Veth W Above and Below, and you need health, not resistances, to withstand the true damage from Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.fight: After dodging Bel’Veth W Above and Below, start the fight before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw to build armor stacks, and land basic attacks from an angle with no units in between. After Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, pour on damage with Graves Q End of the Line and Graves R Collateral Damage.
Belveth.laning: In early jungle skirmishes, pressure Bel’Veth while she has few stacks, and steal large monsters and camps to slow her growth. Look for ganks when the opponent is past the lane’s midpoint and an ally has a way to lock them down. If there’s no clear opening, stick Graves Q End of the Line to a wall and clear camps quickly to gain levels and gold.
Belveth.combo: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below, then close in with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Follow with Graves W Smoke Screen to cut off vision and use Graves Q End of the Line, but if Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, save the explosion damage until it ends. Just before reloading, use Graves E Quickdraw to refill your ammo and keep attacking, then finish with Graves R Collateral Damage.
Belveth.escape: Don’t go in as soon as Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is used once. Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below, then look for the brief window before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. She can’t immediately reuse the direction she dashed in, so move relative to that axis and use Graves E Quickdraw to manage distance. If you’re in danger, cast Graves W Smoke Screen behind you to cut off your pursuer’s vision, then escape with the knockback from Graves R Collateral Damage.
Belveth.phase: In the mid game, turn Graves’ strengths into objective and vision advantages. Bel’Veth grows stronger in the late game through the permanent stacks from Bel’Veth P Death in Lavender, while Graves is vulnerable if caught first, so avoid taking the same kind of frontal fight.
Belveth.teamfight: Don’t start team fights with Graves. Wait for your allies to draw attention, then enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw. Attack from a position where no unit is between you and your target, and focus your damage after Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends. If an ally dies and drops Void Coral, back away before Bel’Veth picks it up, and delay the fight while Bel’Veth’s transformation is active.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can quickly approach along the trail, so don’t run straight away; turn toward an ally or turret. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only fears you if the tether stays connected, so use Graves E Quickdraw to create distance as soon as it attaches. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and doubles Nocturne’s attack speed if it blocks one, so don’t use an important ability right away while the spell shield is active.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades interferes with a kill, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Nocturne.fight: Close the gap with Graves E Quickdraw to build armor stacks, and land basic attacks from a position where no other unit is between you and Nocturne. Don’t go too deep without a way to create distance in case of Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.laning: Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances, and decide where to retreat toward your allies before Nocturne R Paranoia activates. Gank when the opponent is past the lane’s midpoint and your ally can lock them down. If there’s no clear opening, farm camps to gain levels and gold.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, strip the spell shield first with Graves Q End of the Line. Close in with Graves E Quickdraw and land basic attacks. If Graves E Quickdraw is available again just before reloading, use it to refill your ammo and keep attacking. After Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, stay close and use Graves W Smoke Screen to cut off vision, then hit Nocturne with the explosion from Graves Q End of the Line while he has his back to a wall.
Nocturne.escape: When Nocturne R Paranoia is down, you have a chance to close in with Graves E Quickdraw. Conversely, if Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethers you, use Graves E Quickdraw to get out of range and break the fear.
Nocturne.phase: In the mid game, use Graves R Collateral Damage to finish enemies and turn your advantage into objective and vision control. Graves grows stronger as he builds up, so surviving the early game makes the matchup more favorable over time. In the late game, be careful not to get caught first because of your short range.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t spread out; immediately group with your allies. Don’t start the fight from the front. Wait for your allies to draw Nocturne’s attention, then enter from the flank with Graves E Quickdraw. When attacking, stay where no other unit is between you and your target.
